name: Valley Surface Extraction via Point Seeding and Convergence
definition: A mesh-free surface extraction method that grows a surface by seeding points on an adaptive ellipsoid around existing surface points and converging them to the valley surface (maximal convexity ridge) using polynomial approximation or Newton iteration.
summary: This mesh-free algorithm extracts adaptive valley surfaces from complex scalar fields by seeding points on ellipsoids and converging them, avoiding triangulation.
